model: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: organic AFFO growth (escalators ~2.8% + new leases/amendments ~2% - normal churn ~2%, international faster) less refinancing drag; book-equity CAGR unusable (equity negative since FY2014), FCF CAGR unusable (reported FCF nets acquisition capex: FY2025 $1.2M after the ~$975M Millicom deal)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR undefined (negative book equity from debt-funded buybacks). GAAP EPS CAGR (FY22 $4.27 -> FY25 $9.83) is dominated by FX remeasurement and the $226M Canada sale gain - not a growth signal. Revenue 3yr CAGR 2.25% vs 5yr 6.21%: the 2021-22 acquisition burst and 2023-25 Sprint/EchoStar churn plus market exits (Philippines, Colombia, Argentina, Canada).
historical_growth.notes: FY2025 owner FCF on a reported basis (OCF $1,291.3M - capex $1,290.1M - SBC $75.7M) is negative only because capex includes the Millicom acquisition; AFFO is the right flow. OCF has been flat ~$1.29-1.54B since FY2022 while interest costs rose - the same stagnation AFFO/share shows (Q2 $3.17 -> $3.05).

scenario_narratives.base: Tower leasing resumes ~4% organic growth in 2027 once the Sprint and EchoStar churn ($112M, ~4% of site leasing revenue) rolls off, but the refinancing of 2020-21 tower securities and senior notes at ~5%+ absorbs most of the operating leverage until ~2031. House AFFO (company AFFO less the SBC add-back) grows ~4%/yr from $11.34/share, capitalised at a 9.75% cost of equity.
scenario_narratives.bull: A 5G mid-band/Auction 115 amendment cycle plus Central America and Brazil colocation push organic growth back to 5-5.5%, rates ease so the refi wave is cheap, and the IG rating lowers the equity's risk premium: AFFO/share compounds ~7%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Carrier consolidation or another tenant failure repeats the 2025-26 churn, EM currencies fall, and refinancing at 6%+ outruns growth: house AFFO stalls in nominal terms for several years, valued at a 10.5% cost of equity.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the post-interest AFFO stream SBA actually distributes or reinvests, net of SBC, at the cost of equity; never subtract net debt (it is already inside AFFO through net cash interest). Growth is organic only, because discretionary build/acquisition capex is not deducted. The key judgment is how much of the 2027-31 refinancing wave eats operating leverage.
key_risks_to_valuation: Carrier churn: T-Mobile/AT&T/Verizon are ~66.5% of revenue; EchoStar has already defaulted; further consolidation or network-sharing would repeat the FY26 churn.
Refinancing: ~$5.5B of 1.6-3.9% coupon debt rolls 2026-2031; every 100bp on that tranche is ~$55M (~4.5%) of AFFO.
Cost of equity: the 10y UST is the dominant lever; +/-50bp on the 9.75% CoE moves base IV by roughly 8%.
FX: ~30% of site leasing revenue is BRL/ZAR/Central America - USD AFFO absorbs EM depreciation.
Capital allocation: discretionary capex ($455-475M/yr) and buybacks are assumed to earn the cost of capital; value-destructive acquisitions would make the base too high.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 157.35-224.46 (trading at the low).
data_sources.financials: SBAC_Metrics.csv (SEC XBRL, FY2007-Q2 2026) for history; SEC EDGAR 8-K ex99.1 earnings releases of 2026-02-26 (Q4-25, FY26 initial outlook) and 2026-08-03 (Q2-26, updated FY26 outlook, AFFO reconciliation, net-debt table) for AFFO, non-cash compensation, notional debt and guidance.

inputs.debt_memo: Held at ZERO in the engine because AFFO is already after net cash interest; subtracting debt again would charge it twice. Actual balance sheet at 2026-06-30 (Q2-26 earnings release ex99.1, notional principal): total debt $12,778.3M ($9,778.3M secured tower securities + revolver/term loan, $3,000M senior notes), cash/ST restricted/ST investments $384.9M, net debt $12,393.3M = 6.4x annualised Adjusted EBITDA ($1,935.3M), target range 6.0-7.0x. The XBRL TotalDebt of $16,307.8M in Metrics.csv is NOT principal (it carries finance-lease/other liabilities or double-counts the current portion) - do not use it. Post quarter end (2026-07-23): $3.5B IG senior unsecured notes at a blended 5.113% repaid the $1.055B revolver and $2.2B 2024 term loan; S&P upgraded to BBB.
inputs.sbc_source: Q2-26 earnings release (8-K 2026-08-03 ex99.1) FY2026 AFFO reconciliation: non-cash compensation $82.0-87.0M added back in company AFFO; house basis removes the add-back (midpoint $84.5M). FY2025 cash-flow SBC $75.7M (Metrics.csv).
inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted average 106.3M = the share base of the FY2026 AFFO-per-share guidance (Q2-26 diluted WASO 106.264M). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flow, and buybacks (resuming H2-2026, $1.1B authorisation remaining) are funded from retained AFFO/incremental leverage, whose value is already inside the capitalised AFFO stream. No OP units (not an UPREIT).
inputs.wacc_rationale: Discount rate is the COST OF EQUITY (the AFFO stream is post-interest): 10y UST 5.24% (2026-10-01) + 0.90 x 5.0% ERP = 9.74%, rounded 9.75%. Beta at the upper end of the REIT range for 6.4x leverage, 66.5% revenue from three US carriers (one tenant, EchoStar, already defaulted) and ~30% EM-currency revenue (BRL, ZAR, Central America). Bull 9.0% (rates ease, IG rating lowers equity risk); bear 10.5%.
inputs.lease_treatment: Ground leases are an operating cost inside Adjusted EBITDA and therefore inside AFFO; non-cash straight-line ground-lease expense is removed in the company's AFFO. No separate lease charge (lease_cost_pct_path 0) - charging it again would double count.
inputs.nci_treatment: Stream is AFFO ATTRIBUTABLE to SBA (after the ~$4M joint-venture partner interest), so no NCI deduction in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity on the dcf_engine route (same pattern as PSA/MAA/O). SBAC is a tower REIT: dcf-methods routing table -> REIT row; an owner-FCF DCF on EBITDA less net debt would also work for towers, but SBA reports, guides and is priced on AFFO, and a post-interest stream at CoE makes the ~$5.1% refinancing wave on cheap 2020-21 tower securities explicit in the margin path rather than hidden in a WACC. Negative book equity (-$4.6B) is the residue of debt-funded buybacks and is not a data error; P/B is meaningless here. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = total revenue (FY26 guide midpoint $2,863.5M = site leasing $2,663.5M + site development $200M); 'EBITDA' = company AFFO attributable to SBA (FY26 midpoint $1,290.0M = 45.05% of revenue), which ALREADY includes the company's add-back of non-cash compensation ($84.5M midpoint); sbc_pct_path then deducts SBC once, so the house stream FY26 = $1,205.5M = $11.34/share vs company AFFO $12.14/share. D&A, cash tax, capex and working capital are 0 in the engine because AFFO already deducts cash taxes, net cash interest and non-discretionary capex ($65-75M). Discretionary capex ($455-475M FY26: ~600 US builds, Millicom build-to-suit, land purchases) is NOT deducted, and growth paths are correspondingly ORGANIC only (escalators + new leases/amendments - churn); builds/acquisitions are assumed to earn their cost of capital. Margin path is where the interest wave lives: 2021-1C ($1,165M @1.63%) refinances Nov-26 at ~5.25%, then 2020-2C, 2021-2C, the 2020/2021 senior notes (3.875%/3.125%) and 2021-3C refinance 2027-2031 at ~5.0-5.5% - roughly $130M of net annual interest drag by 2031, which offsets most of the EBITDA operating leverage until ~FY2031. PRICE sits at the 52-week low.

bear.growth_rationale: Another churn event (US carrier network-sharing or consolidation, spectrum-holder exits like EchoStar) and a weak carrier capex cycle hold US leasing flat; BRL/ZAR depreciation eats international growth in USD.
bear.margin_rationale: Higher-for-longer: the 2027-31 refinancing wave prices at 6%+, and leverage has to fall toward 6.0x, so interest drag outruns operating leverage; AFFO margin slides ~1.6pp.

base.growth_rationale: Total revenue organic growth: FY27 rebounds to ~4% once the $112M of FY26 Sprint-consolidation + EchoStar churn is through (FY26 domestic site leasing -3.7% YoY in Q2); US escalators ~3% + amendments from mid-band/Auction 115 deployments, international 5-6% organic; fading to 3% as US densification matures.
base.margin_rationale: Company AFFO/revenue (SBC still added back, 45.05% in FY26): ~75% incremental EBITDA margin on organic growth (+~0.6pp/yr) is offset by ~$25-35M/yr of net refinancing drag as 1.6-3.9% coupons roll to ~5.1-5.5% through 2031 (term-loan/revolver refi at 5.11% is a small offset). Flat ~45.3-45.6% to FY2031, then expands as the refi wave ends.

bull.growth_rationale: Auction 115 / upper C-band and early 6G overlay drive a US amendment cycle like 2019-22; Millicom and Brazil colocation lift international organic growth to high single digits; no further carrier consolidation churn.
bull.margin_rationale: Rates ease so refinancing lands near 4.5-5.0% (IG unsecured curve), and operating leverage dominates: +0.4pp/yr.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 16x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 20% because the EchoStar default and 66.5% three-carrier concentration show churn events are not hypothetical, and leverage at 6.4x leaves the equity rate-sensitive. Bull held at 30% (below the 35% default): the amendment-cycle upside is real but AFFO/share has fallen two years running. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)

diagnosis.detail: Base year FCF 1,205.5 is 9.0x the historical median 134.5
Structural risks in the qualitative analysis that a standard WACC may not price: customer concentration, cyclicality, regulatory single point of failure
